title: Parameterization method of reservoir properties for ensemble-based data assimilation using intermediate latent space of StyleGAN
abstract: arXiv:2609.39626v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensemble smoothers are the most successful and efficient techniques currently available for history matching. However, because these methods rely on Gaussian assumptions, their performance is severely degraded when the prior geology is described in terms of complex facies distributions (non-Gaussian). In this way, for these methods, we need to apply efficient parameterization techniques. Currently, the most efficient methods for performing parameterization are deep learning models. However, given the variety of existing deep learning models, studies have not identified which is most suitable for use with ensemble-based methods, although some important models had already been evaluated. Based on a recent literature review, the most promising models selected were VAE-GAN, Latent Diffusion, and StyleGAN models. translated_title: 基于StyleGAN中间潜在空间的储层物性参数化方法用于基于集合的数据同化
translated_abstract: 集合平滑方法是当前最成功、最高效的历史拟合技术。然而，由于这些方法依赖于高斯假设，当先验地质以复杂相分布（非高斯）描述时，其性能会严重下降。因此，对于这些方法，需要应用高效的参数化技术。目前，执行参数化最有效的方法是深度学习模型。然而，鉴于现有深度学习模型的多样性，尽管已经评估过一些重要模型，但研究尚未确定哪种模型最适合与基于集合的方法配合使用。基于近期的文献综述，选出的最有前景的模型是VAE-GAN、潜在扩散模型和StyleGAN模型。作为本工作的创新之处，使用第二代StyleGAN（StyleGAN2）模型进行了数据同化，利用其
tldr: 本研究提出利用StyleGAN2的中间潜在空间对储层物性进行参数化，以克服集合数据同化方法在处理非高斯复杂地质（复杂相分布）条件下历史拟合性能下降的问题，并与VAE-GAN和潜在扩散模型等深度学习参数化方案进行了对比评估。
en_tdlr: This work proposes parameterizing reservoir properties through the intermediate latent space of StyleGAN2 to enable ensemble-based data assimilation (history matching) under complex non-Gaussian geology, comparing it against VAE-GAN and Latent Diffusion models.
